title: The Gatekeeper
synopsis: Kit installs a friendly gatekeeper in every agent so PRs go through Tracetoon by default, with an off switch at every level.
altText: Panel 1: Sam asks why Tracetoon only runs when an agent remembers it. Panel 2: Kit studies how other tools do it and plans a hook for every agent. Panel 3: Glitch tries to sneak a direct gh pr create past, and the hook stops him. Panel 4: Kit shows Sam the switches, and Sam is pleased it can be turned off anywhere.

panels.scene: Sam asks why Tracetoon only works when an agent remembers it

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: Shouldn't installing it make it the default?

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Right now, agents can just skip it.

panels.scene: Kit researches how other tools hook into agents

dialogue.speaker: caption
dialogue.text: Entire, git-ai, Husky, pre-commit: they all use hooks and kill switches.

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: A hook for every agent, then.

panels.scene: Glitch tries to sneak a direct gh pr create past the hook

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.text: Just a quick gh pr create...

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: On by default. Off per command, repo or you.
